fivem.label: FiveM
fivem.description: Allows role verification on the FiveM server

fivem_config_read.label: FiveM: view settings
fivem_config_read.description: Allows reading the module settings. Do not give this permission to the key that lives in server.cfg.

fivem_config_write.label: FiveM: change settings
fivem_config_write.description: Allows changing linking, entry, nickname, role actions, ACE permissions and status panels. Can grant admin power in game. Do not give it to the key that lives in server.cfg.

mta.label: MTA
mta.description: Allows linking and role verification on the MTA server

mta_config_read.label: MTA: view settings
mta_config_read.description: Allows reading the module settings. The server password is never shown. Do not give it to the game server key.

mta_config_write.label: MTA: change settings
mta_config_write.description: Allows changing linking, entry and status panels. The server address and password stay in the dashboard only. Do not give it to the game server key.

media_write.label: Media: upload
media_write.description: Allows uploading and deleting files. This is the scope for the game server resource.

media_read.label: Media: list
media_read.description: Allows listing the library and viewing usage. Do not give this to the game server key.

projects.label: Projects
projects.description: Unlocks the boards and tasks API: read, create, edit, move and delete.

storefront_read.label: Store: read
storefront_read.description: Allows reading the store, the draft, the version history and which payment methods are active.

storefront_write.label: Store: edit draft
storefront_write.description: Allows editing and discarding the draft. Nothing goes live without publishing.

storefront_publish.label: Store: publish
storefront_publish.description: Allows publishing the draft, restoring old versions and changing the visible page. The change goes live immediately.

storefront_settings.label: Store: settings
storefront_settings.description: Allows changing the store address, turning the store on or off, the sales channel and the custom domain. Goes live immediately.

products_read.label: Products: read
products_read.description: Allows reading products and categories. Only the delivery type (role, file, command) shows, without details.

products_write.label: Products: edit
products_write.description: Allows creating, editing, reordering and archiving products and categories. Goes live immediately; delivery can only be copied from another product and is edited in the dashboard.

coupons_write.label: Coupons: edit
coupons_write.description: Allows creating, editing and deleting discount coupons. Applies immediately.

sales_read.label: Sales: read
sales_read.description: Allows reading store sales, with buyer and transaction. Refunds and redelivery stay in the dashboard only.

plans_read.label: Plans: read
plans_read.description: Allows reading the subscription plans as they appear in the store (without the plan actions).

plans_write.label: Plans: edit
plans_write.description: Allows changing the name, benefits, images, order, visibility, price, discount, packages and donation of the plans. Goes live immediately; plan actions (role, command) stay in the dashboard only.

subscribers_read.label: Subscribers: read
subscribers_read.description: Allows reading subscribers, with email, charges and purchases. Cancelling and refunding stay in the dashboard only.

selectors_read.label: Role selector: read
selectors_read.description: Allows reading the role panels and the options of each one.

selectors_write.label: Role selector: edit
selectors_write.description: Allows creating, editing, deleting, publishing and removing role panels from the channel. Goes live immediately. The panel can offer any role below the bot, including an administrator one.

admin_read.label: Discord Admin: read
admin_read.description: Allows reading welcome, auto roles, channel logs, synced nickname and moderation settings.

admin_write.label: Discord Admin: edit
admin_write.description: Allows changing welcome, auto roles, channel logs, synced nickname and moderation settings. The auto role can be any role below the bot, including an administrator one. Ban, kick, mute and raid mode stay in the dashboard only.

member_counter_read.label: Member counter: read
member_counter_read.description: Allows reading the member counter settings and numbers.

member_counter_write.label: Member counter: edit
member_counter_write.description: Allows changing the counter and publishing its message in the channel.

community_read.label: Community: read
community_read.description: Allows reading the settings for suggestions, bugs, anonymous messages and the staff form, and the form openings.

community_write.label: Community: edit
community_write.description: Allows changing the settings for suggestions, bugs, anonymous messages and the staff form, creating and deleting openings and publishing the panels. Goes live immediately; deciding suggestions, triaging bugs and reading applications stay in the dashboard only.

referrals_read.label: Referrals: read
referrals_read.description: Allows reading the referral settings and milestones. Who invited whom stays in the dashboard only.

referrals_write.label: Referrals: edit
referrals_write.description: Allows changing the settings and milestones. Assigning invites, recalculating and resetting the season stay in the dashboard only.

tickets_read.label: Tickets: read
tickets_read.description: Allows reading the ticket settings (types, panels, hours, canned replies) and the numbers.

tickets_write.label: Tickets: edit
tickets_write.description: Allows changing the ticket settings and publishing the panel. Goes live immediately; conversations, closing tickets and the block list stay in the dashboard only.

giveaways_read.label: Giveaways: read
giveaways_read.description: Allows reading the giveaways, settings, templates and the numbers of each giveaway.

giveaways_write.label: Giveaways: edit
giveaways_write.description: Allows creating, editing, ending, cancelling and rerolling, and changing settings and templates. Goes live immediately; who entered and permanent deletion stay in the dashboard only.

polls_read.label: Polls: read
polls_read.description: Allows reading the polls and results.

polls_write.label: Polls: edit
polls_write.description: Allows creating, editing, ending and reposting polls. Goes live immediately; who voted and permanent deletion stay in the dashboard only.

messages_read.label: Messages: read
messages_read.description: Allows reading the bot messages (sent, scheduled, recurring and drafts) and the templates.

messages_write.label: Messages: edit
messages_write.description: Allows sending, scheduling, editing and cancelling bot messages and changing the templates. Goes live immediately; deleting messages stays in the dashboard only.

gamification_read.label: Gamification: read
gamification_read.description: Allows reading the XP settings, level roles and multipliers.

gamification_write.label: Gamification: edit
gamification_write.description: Allows changing the XP settings, level roles and multipliers. Changing a member XP and resetting XP stay in the dashboard only.

social_read.label: Social alerts: read
social_read.description: Allows reading which creators are announced and in which channel.

social_write.label: Social alerts: edit
social_write.description: Allows adding, changing and removing creators and sending a test alert to the channel.

boost_read.label: Boost: read
boost_read.description: Allows reading the boost settings and rewards.

boost_write.label: Boost: edit
boost_write.description: Allows changing the boost settings. Rewards have their own permission.

boost_rewards_write.label: Boost: rewards
boost_rewards_write.description: Allows creating, changing and removing rewards. Removing a reward takes back what it gave, in game and in the store. Applying to existing boosters stays in the dashboard only.

whitelist_read.label: Whitelist: read
whitelist_read.description: Allows reading the whitelist form, the answer key and the settings.

whitelist_write.label: Whitelist: edit
whitelist_write.description: Allows changing the form, the answer key, the channels and the approved role, which can be any role below the bot, including an administrator one. Goes live immediately; viewing applications, approving and rejecting stay in the dashboard only. Access codes have their own permission.

whitelist_codes_read.label: Whitelist: view codes
whitelist_codes_read.description: Allows reading the access codes. Who redeemed each one stays in the dashboard only.

whitelist_codes_write.label: Whitelist: create codes
whitelist_codes_write.description: Allows creating, disabling and deleting access codes. Anyone with a code skips the form.

ai_helper_read.label: AI assistant: read
ai_helper_read.description: Allows reading the documentation sources, the knowledge base and the accuracy numbers.

ai_helper_write.label: AI assistant: edit
ai_helper_write.description: Allows adding, updating and removing documentation sources and changing the knowledge base. Settings and providers have their own permission.

ai_helper_config_read.label: AI assistant: view settings and errors
ai_helper_config_read.description: Allows reading the settings, providers and recent errors. Each provider key is never shown.

ai_helper_config_write.label: AI assistant: change settings
ai_helper_config_write.description: Allows changing the settings, testing providers and changing their order and model. Adding a provider, its key and URL stay in the dashboard only.

planning_read.label: Planning: read
planning_read.description: Allows reading the planning documents and templates.

planning_write.label: Planning: edit
planning_write.description: Allows creating, editing, archiving and unarchiving documents. Permanent deletion stays in the dashboard only.

voice_read.label: Voice: read
voice_read.description: Allows reading the "join to create" channels and their settings.

voice_write.label: Voice: edit
voice_write.description: Allows creating, changing and removing "join to create" channels.

modules_write.label: Modules: turn on and off
modules_write.description: Allows turning server modules on and off, with the same plan limits. Turning one off takes the module down immediately.

discord_read.label: Discord: view roles and channels
discord_read.description: Allows listing the roles, channels and the permissions the key can grant.

discord_setup.label: Discord: set up the server
discord_setup.description: Allows creating and editing roles and channels and changing channel permissions through MRI BOT, including those of @everyone, which affects the whole server, and opening private channels. Deleting, banning and granting administrator power stay with you on Discord.
